notes: The engineering package lives in Tools and uses its existing npm package-lock.
Local artifact generation, Worker API deployment and R2 publishing are distinct capabilities.
Only the existing typecheck script is declared. generate-local.ts writes local artifacts, but its asset lookup can search ancestor directories and needs a confined input root before registration.
Tools has no test or build script. Do not replace build with wrangler deploy or R2 push.
Artifact generation requires fonts, books and database inputs plus optional platform binaries; it remains separate from type checking.
